messages:
Tariq A: flagging trial acct 'SkyLedger' (sl-2207)  went quiet after hitting repeated 429s on ingestion. renewal check in 28 days and CSM reports exec nervous.
Mei Z: do we have the error payload? is it our rate limiter or their volume spike?
Tariq A: user report said 'Too many requests' from our /ingest endpoint. dashboard shows burst of 8k events/min then drop to zero.
Rohan P: likely our default per-tenant qps cap. can we provision a short-term bump and enable per-customer burst window?
Claire S: propose immediate save plan: 1) enable a 72h elevated ingestion window for sl-2207, 2) schedule a 30-min integration triage with their infra lead, 3) offer a prorated first-month credit + a migration package if they convert in 14 days.
Mei Z: engineering can toggle `ingest_burst=true` for that tenant and set `burst_ttl_hours=72`. command: `curl -X POST https://internal.api/customers/sl-2207/flags -d '{"ingest_burst":true,"burst_ttl_hours":72}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'`
Rohan P: will add audit entry and auto-revert. also adding a temporary increased token bucket for 72h. patch in progress.
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-8892 assigned to Claire S  "SkyLedger ingestion surge save + conversion incentive". Due: 2027-02-12
Tariq A: Claire can you schedule the triage? invite: their infra lead, our solutions eng (Rohan), and me. agenda: repro, short-term bump, long-term ingestion plan.
Claire S: scheduled Wed 11am ET. included a 1-pager: safe bump, audit, rollback plan, and example traffic patterns we'll accept. added short enablement checklist to invite.
Mei Z: tech note: after the bump we should add a regression test to the ingestion harness to simulate 10k rps bursts to avoid silent cap hits. filing tech debt.
Rohan P: flag enabled, audit_id=aud-cc9a. monitoring now. will post metrics snapshot in 15m.
Tariq A: commercial note: also prep a downgrade pathway in ticket in case they ask to step down: bullets please (prorated, data export guarantees, 60-day reactivation credit).
Claire S: added downgrade bullets to ticket-8892: - prorated downgrade to Essentials for first billing cycle - maintain export access and one snapshot on request for 90 days - 60-day reactivation credit (40% off) if they return within window.
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-8892] status updated -> in-progress (Claire S).
Mei Z: monitoring shows ingestion recovered after bump; 0 error rate after 10m. looks like burst was upstream queueing; recommended long-term: increase default burst window and add better client-side backpressure docs.
Tariq A: great. Claire please collect 3 quick post-call feedback items: 1) what caused the burst, 2) which step failed for them, 3) how sensitive are they to price vs uptime. paste here and I'll convert to product eval.
Claire S: will collect. also added a short neutral CSM script to the ticket for framing the conversion credit and downgrade option.
Rohan P: follow-up: implementing auto-alert when any trial crosses 5k rps for >5min so CSMs get early heads-up. filing infra task and adding to ticket-8892.
Tariq A: marking account as 'at-risk: ingestion throttled' and setting renewal follow-up in 14 days. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
CS Ops Bot: reminder -> triage Wed 11am ET; ticket-8892 assigned to Claire S.
